verifiedCheckpoint.name: LOCAL-OPERATION-IDENTITY-OWNERSHIP-VERIFIED
verifiedCheckpoint.meaning: The shared five-family local OperationID ownership guard and its complete current-family matrix are verified; a later provider may add one centrally registered family/relation through its own gated slice.

activeBatch.outcome: Complete the provider-backed offline Item-to-Space clearing workflow and its separately owned Budget-category test-drainage correction without adding unrelated Item, accounting, media, hosted, migration, or production behavior.
nextActions: Commit and push the exact reviewed implementation checkpoint that passed the complete local gate.
Dispatch CI for that exact commit and require every immutable workflow job to pass.
Promote the clearing provider and Budget operational proof to verified only after exact CI.

efficiency.measurementStart: The recreated Codex goal began at zero tokens on 2026-09-06; record goal token and elapsed-time deltas at each integrated batch checkpoint.
efficiency.qualityOverride: Correctness and required evidence outrank throughput targets.

blockers: A canonical immutable production export or acceptable project-matching service-account access is still required for production-profile evidence.
Hosted Supabase and PowerSync resources, credentials, spending and authenticated rehearsal require explicit user authorization.
A-003 and A-004 remain proposed until the complete vertical-spike exit gate passes.
guardrails: Do not implement redesigned behavior in Firebase.
Do not access or mutate production systems or production data.
Do not create paid or hosted resources, migrate data, freeze Firebase, release, or cut over without explicit user approval.

resume.readHistoryOnlyWhen: The compact state or active dossier lacks evidence needed for a concrete decision, audit, or discrepancy investigation.
